content.title: API Health - KPI Summary
content.query:
requests
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| summarize
    TotalRequests = count(),
    FailedRequests = countif(success == false),
    FailureRate = round(100.0 * countif(success == false) / count(), 2),
    AvgResponseMs = round(avg(duration), 2),
    P95ResponseMs = round(percentile(duration, 95), 2)

content.title: Request Volume and Failure Trend
content.query:
requests
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| summarize
    Requests = count(),
    FailedRequests = countif(success == false)
    by bin(timestamp, 1h)
| order by timestamp asc

content.title: API Operation Performance
content.query:
requests
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| summarize
    RequestCount = count(),
    AvgResponseMs = round(avg(duration), 2),
    P95ResponseMs = round(percentile(duration, 95), 2),
    FailedRequests = countif(success == false)
    by name
| order by RequestCount desc

content.title: Recent API Failures
content.query:
requests
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| where success == false or toint(resultCode) >= 500
| project
    timestamp,
    name,
    resultCode,
    duration,
    operation_Id,
    url
| order by timestamp desc
| take 3

content.title: Exception Analysis
content.query:
exceptions
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| summarize ExceptionCount = count() by type
| order by ExceptionCount desc

content.title: API Availability
content.query:
availabilityResults
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| summarize
    TotalTests = count(),
    SuccessfulTests = countif(success == true),
    FailedTests = countif(success == false),
    AvailabilityPct = round(
        100.0 * countif(success == true) / count(), 2
    ),
    AvgDurationMs = round(avg(duration), 2)
    by name, location

content.title: Azure Resource Inventory
content.query:
Resources
| where subscriptionId == '8bb846b6-1057-42bb-a02a-7a64e6a34178'
| where resourceGroup =~ 'rg-portfolio'
| project name, type, location, kind
| order by type asc

content.title: Monitoring Rules and Health Checks
content.query:
Resources
| where subscriptionId == '8bb846b6-1057-42bb-a02a-7a64e6a34178'
| where resourceGroup =~ 'rg-portfolio'
| where type in~ (
    'microsoft.insights/scheduledqueryrules',
    'microsoft.insights/metricalerts',
    'microsoft.insights/actiongroups',
    'microsoft.insights/webtests'
)
| extend Enabled = tostring(properties.enabled)
| project name, type, location, Enabled
| order by type asc
